en.headline: Sa Sa Ladies' Purse Day returns to Sha Tin Racecourse today
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club stages the annual raceday at Sha Tin on Sunday, with the feature Ladies' Purse over 1,800 metres and fashion and performance events in the Parade Ring.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club is holding Sa Sa Ladies' Purse Day at Sha Tin Racecourse on Sunday, 8 November, under the theme Race in Style.

Gates open at 10:30am. An opening performance in the Parade Ring begins at 11:20am, featuring singer Kenny Kwan. The first race starts at 12:30pm, and the themed Ladies' Purse race is scheduled for 4:05pm over 1,800 metres.

The Ladies' Purse dates back to 1846 and is one of the longest-established races in Hong Kong. Racegoers are invited to wear pink for a chance to enter the Best Dressed Award. A fashion show by Hong Kong Design Institute graduates is also planned.
According to the Jockey Club, the event continues the raceday's tradition of combining racing with entertainment and themed activities.

zh.headline: 莎莎婦女銀袋日今日重返沙田馬場
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會周日在沙田舉行年度賽馬日，焦點為一千八百米婦女銀袋賽，亮相圈設時裝及表演活動。
body: 香港賽馬會今日（8日）在沙田馬場舉行莎莎婦女銀袋日，主題為「賽出時尚」。
開閘時間為上午10時30分。上午11時20分在馬匹亮相圈有開幕表演，歌手關智斌將演出。首場賽事下午12時30分開跑，主題婦女銀袋賽定於下午4時05分舉行，途程一千八百米。
婦女銀袋賽自1846年開始，是香港歷史最悠久的賽事之一。入場人士可穿粉紅色服裝參與最佳服飾獎。香港知專設計學院畢業生亦會進行時裝匯演。
賽馬會表示，是次活動延續賽馬日結合賽事與娛樂的傳統。
